title: Structural Work Risk Assessment
description: Free Structural Work Risk Assessment template for construction you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers project information, structural integrity control plan, fall protection plan - osha 29 cfr 1926 subpart m.
standard: OSHA 29 Cfr 1926 Subpart R - Steel Erection

INSPECTOR: ______________ DATE: ______________ TIME: ______________ WEATHER: ______________

ITEMCOMPLIANTNON-COMPLIANTN/AREMARKS
1. Structural drawings available and current
2. Erection sequence plan reviewed
3. Temporary bracing in place per design
4. All connections properly torqued/welded
5. Fall protection systems in place and inspected
6. Anchor points verified and adequate
7. Guard rails installed where required
8. Floor openings covered or guarded
9. Perimeter protection adequate
10. Crane/lifting equipment inspected
11. Rigging gear inspected and certified
12. Tag lines used on suspended loads
13. Exclusion zones established and respected
14. Material storage areas organized and stable
15. Housekeeping maintained - no trip hazards
16. Weather conditions safe for work
17. Lighting adequate for work area
18. PPE being worn correctly (hard hat, vest, etc.)
19. Fire extinguishers available for hot work
20. Emergency procedures posted and understood		☐
